title: dbg_bundle_gen's null-control rows are a diverged copy of cycle_row; feed self-test raises on them
claim: Every row tools/replay/dbg_bundle_gen.py writes differs from what debugger.cycle_row writes for the same payload (48 of 48 in one day), and debugger.feed_health raises TypeError on those rows, so D15's mandated null control cannot run M7's self-test re-derivation.
mechanism: build_bundle.recording_tick builds the row with its own dict literal instead of calling debugger.cycle_row: it keeps keys whose value is None (production drops them), carries no version, records an accuracy sample without its t, and measures wall around _async_update_data. feed_health compares weather_stale_h > 0 on every row carrying the key, which production never writes as None.

evidence.unit: rows diverging from cycle_row of 48 generated (rows_with_explicit_none=48, samples_without_t=47, feed_health_completes=False)
evidence.contention_note: shared box, load1 about 12; counts, contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb production-row: the one-line generator edit row = debugger.cycle_row(self, data, dt_util.now(), wall_ms), applied in memory to build_bundle's source

metric_definition: Rows of one generated day whose keys or values differ from debugger.cycle_row's row for the same coordinator and payload at the same tick (solve_wall_ms compared by presence only).
phenomenon_property: The null-control bundle's rows, snapshots and manifest are produced by the production collector's own functions, so every production reader that runs on a real bundle runs unchanged on the synthetic one.

null_control.note: production's own rows for the same payloads, captured in the same run, are read by feed_health without error

reproduction_steps: Run the command: 48 diverging rows, feed_health raises TypeError.
On a 7-day generated bundle, m7_rowscan.py prints feeds_rederived_equal=error:TypeError and rows_with_explicit_none=336 while the owner's real bundle prints feeds_rederived_equal=True.
Re-run with --perturb production-row: 0 diverging rows, feed_health completes.
proposed_fix_scope: tools/replay/dbg_bundle_gen.py builds rows (and the snapshot's t and JSON-text data, and the manifest's self_tests via debugger.run_self_tests) through debugger's functions; its gate_checks gains one arm that runs debugger.feed_health and sensor_sanity on a generated row.
